Check GPS track gaps

Source: R/gps_validation.R
gps_check_gaps.Rd

Finds large gaps and non-positive intervals between successive fixes within each GPS stream. Use this before appending continuous segment_id values.

Usage

gps_check_gaps(
  data,
  large_gap_mins = 60,
  groups = NULL,
  return_class = c("data.frame", "data.table")
)

Arguments

data

Input data frame with standard GPS columns.

large_gap_mins

Positive number. Intervals longer than this are flagged as large gaps.

groups

Optional grouping columns. Defaults to deployment_id and sensor_id when deployment_id is present, otherwise sensor_id.

return_class

Output class: "data.frame" (default) or "data.table".

Value

A data frame with one row per large gap or non-positive interval.
